AMV Hell has come a long, long way since it premièred 10 years ago, creating an entire genre of AMVs. Alas, video and internet technology have also come a long way in the past 10 years and the original project is showing it's age.

 

As such, this project is intended to remaster the one that started it all, AMV Hell 1!

 

Many, many thanks to Zarxrax and SSGWNBTD for creating it in the first place and for giving many people their first taste of anime and sucking them down the rabbit hole!

 

Technical Guidelines (Courtesy of Zarxrax)

  • The project will be produced at 720p HD resolution, 23.976 fps.

  • Please submit an MP4 file with the highest quality settings you can.

  • Keep the aspect ratio at the correct aspect ratio of your source footage.

  • If your source footage is standard definition, there is no need to upscale it.

  • ~~Try to~~ use the highest quality source footage available.

 

More technical stuff for people who understand it:

  • Its not necessary to submit videos in a lossless or uncompressed format. An MP4 file with the video quantizer set to 15 or lower ought to be visually lossless. Please set your audio to the highest bitrate.

  • Audio should be stereo, not surround.

How to Submit

Upload your file to any file sharing website (Sendspace or MEGA prefered) and send the link to BaconCatBug on the AMV Hell Forums.

Anyone is free to remaster any clip they wish, so be sure to check the Google Document here (pending) for the list of clips completed.

Alternatively, if you can provide the timestamps in the original source for any of the clips and post them here, they will be used to speed up creation of the remake!
